items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: he said, Jacques, I haven't seen you in a long time, come on with me

ctx.x: Oh, when he was still at the --

He was eating people up then. Then I lost track of him because I went to -- and the last time I saw him, we were, he had his automobile and he said, come on with me, he said, Jacques, I haven't seen you in a long time, come on with me -- and this was when I come back, I think it was -- let's see, I can't get the real date. I don't know because it -- can't pinpoint it.
